item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena notices that the dal in her pressure cooker cooks faster on some days than on others.

Her teacher says that a curiosity becomes a scientific question only when it is focused enough to guide careful observation, a fair experiment, and a clear explanation.

Which row shows a question that has been made scientific and a matching way to test it?

options.A: question: Why is cooking dal so interesting?; test: think about it during dinner
options.B: question: Does dal cook faster with more water or less water?; test: cook equal masses of dal with different measured volumes of water, keeping the flame and time the same
options.C: question: Why do all spices do things in food?; test: read a recipe book
options.D: question: What is the best dal in the world?; test: ask friends which dal they like
